en: Hand‑colored historical postcard showing a grand cast‑iron spa colonnade with large arched windows and an ornate pavilion in a spa town. Well‑dressed people in late 19th–early 20th century clothing stroll and sit along the promenade. The caption at the top names the place as Marienbad and refers to the Kreuzbrunnen colonnade and an evening concert. Publisher information is printed vertically on the right edge.
